subject.title: [Bug]: openclaw tui does not honor the active Gateway runtime port and still targets 18789

question: Should default local TUI resolution let a verified active same-config Gateway lock port outrank `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT`, or should the env var keep the documented explicit-port precedence?
rationale: The open fix PR solves the reported bug but changes a Gateway/default-resolution precedence path, and repository policy treats Gateway/config fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Preserve Env Precedence
options.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT` ahead of active lock metadata and use the lock as fallback for config/default cases.

options.title: Approve Active-Lock Precedence
options.body: Let the active lock override env port for default local TUI connections and update docs/tests to make that contract explicit.

options.title: Replace The Dirty Branch
options.body: If the current PR cannot be refreshed cleanly, keep this issue open and land a narrow replacement with the chosen precedence contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve Env Precedence
recommendation.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT` ahead of active lock metadata and use the lock as fallback for config/default cases.

likelyOwner.reason: This account already provided the maintainer follow-up and live proof on the active candidate PR, making them the best available owner for the precedence/rebase decision path.
